title: Open Mic Night @ Vangarde Arts
event_description: Weekly open mic for musicians - singers - poets and comedians. An intimate venue with professional sound equipment and a welcoming atmosphere for performers of all levels.
backline: Drum kit - guitar amps - house PA system provided
event_venue_information:
About Vangarde Arts

Vangarde Arts is an intimate nonprofit arts venue that has become a cornerstone of Sioux City's cultural scene. Located in the heart of downtown - this venue seamlessly blends visual and performance arts in a welcoming atmosphere.

The Venue Experience

With its compact yet well-outfitted space - Vangarde Arts features a gallery lounge and intimate listening room with acoustics that are second to none. The venue has clean facilities and a well-stocked bar - creating a comfortable environment for all visitors.

Music Programming

Beyond the weekly open mic - Vangarde Arts hosts an impressive lineup of touring acts throughout the year. The venue has welcomed legendary musicians like Johnny Winter - John Primer - James McMurtry - and Patricia Barber - as well as rising stars in blues - jazz - rock - folk - and bluegrass. Most ticketed shows take place on Friday and Saturday nights - featuring both nationally acclaimed artists and local original bands.

Community Impact

Open Mic Thursdays have become a community staple - drawing aspiring musicians and supportive audiences. The venue also hosts the annual Alley Art Festival - showcasing over 140 murals in downtown Sioux City's alleys - and presents monthly visual art exhibits featuring local and regional artists.

title: Jam Session @ Lewis & Clark Interpretive Center
event_description: Weekly afternoon jam session in the Betty Strong Auditorium. Free event open to musicians and listeners alike in a historic riverside setting.
venue_address: 900 Larsen Park Road - Sioux City - IA 51103
event_venue_information:
About Lewis & Clark Interpretive Center

The Lewis & Clark Interpretive Center is a 20000-square-foot private nonprofit cultural complex built in 2002 to commemorate the Lewis and Clark Bicentennial. The center showcases the Corps of Discovery's time in the Sioux City area from late July to early September 1804.

Betty Strong Encounter Center

Connected to the main interpretive center - the Betty Strong Encounter Center features galleries - an activity room - and the Betty Strong Auditorium where the weekly jam sessions take place. The center offers free programming and activities exploring themes of land - rivers - and regional culture.

Music & Cultural Programming

Beyond the weekly Thursday jam sessions - the center hosts Sunday afternoon programs featuring talented musicians - artists - dancers - and speakers. The center also features the Spirit of Discovery outdoor stage - which opened in 2023 and hosts summer concerts and community events.

Visitor Information

The center is open Tuesday through Friday 9am-5pm and weekends noon-5pm. Admission is free. Located at 900 Larsen Park Road just off I-29 - the center hosts over 30000 visitors annually and provides free educational programs for all ages.
